introHtml: Wheat straw mints offer a sustainable alternative to traditional plastic packaging. Made from agricultural byproducts, these eco-friendly mints reduce plastic use while keeping your brand top of mind. Ideal for trade shows, office giveaways, or client gifts, they combine a refreshing treat with a clear environmental message. Customize with your logo and choose from several mint flavors to create a memorable, planet-friendly promotional item.
